args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18%. In response, checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Incident opened to document the rollback and for follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 release.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy in production — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions
